title: NANSEN file adapter
description: Declares a file adapter: which files it handles and where its implementation is in each language. An implementation reads a file into a value and writes a value to a file. Built-in adapters (json, text, mat, npy) need no declaration.

python.description: 'module.path:ClassName'. The module is imported from the declaring module's folder. The class has read(path) and write(path, data).

matlab.description: Name of a class with read(obj, path) and write(obj, path, data) methods, on the path while the declaring module is in use. With legacyFileAdapter: dev's class, or the package of dev's function-based adapter.

legacyFileAdapter.description: The MATLAB implementation is a file adapter of NANSEN dev, imported unchanged (adapters.import, the legacy importer): a subclass of nansen.dataio.FileAdapter or of one of dev's adapters (kind class), read with load and written with save, or dev's function-based adapter (kind function), a folder with fileadapter.json whose read and write functions are named here. Only MATLAB reads and writes with it (nansen.legacy.FileAdapterShim); elsewhere it is adapter-unavailable.

read.description: kind function: the function that reads a file, data = read(filename).

write.description: kind function: the function that writes one, write(filename, data); none: the adapter only reads.

base.description: kind class: the class of dev's that the class subclasses instead of nansen.dataio.FileAdapter, one of dev's readers of a known format (its ImageStack, RoiGroup, RoiSignalArray, ...). matlab/devcompat's class of that name reads and writes a file with the adapter of builtIn for its extension, and the class's own code runs on top of it.

builtIn.description: With base: the adapter here that reads and writes a file of each extension in place of dev's base class (the ophys module's, or a built-in one).
